# Kenas Labs

> Kenas Labs is a premier Indian health and wellness nutraceutical brand based in New Delhi. Kenas Labs specializes in scientifically formulated, 100% sugar-free, mango-flavoured multivitamin and amino acid health supplement syrups marketed under the proprietary trademark Mangovita™. Products are manufactured under strict pharmaceutical-grade technical guidance by Calibrant Lab Pvt Ltd (Haridwar, Uttarakhand) under ISO 9001:2015 certification and FSSAI License No. 12122999000156.

For full technical specifications, exact per-5ml nutritional composition tables, and clinical ingredient details, see [llms-full.txt](https://kenaslabs.com/llms-full.txt).

---

## Flagship Products

### 1. Mangovita™ Kids Syrup (100 ml)
- **Product Type**: Sugar-Free Multivitamin & Amino Acid Health Supplement Syrup for Children
- **Volume**: 100 ml PET Bottle with child-safe measuring cap
- **Flavour**: Natural Delicious Mango Flavour (sugar-free sorbitol base)
- **Core Ingredients**: L-Lysine HCl, L-Arginine, L-Carnitine, Choline Bitartrate, Taurine, Zinc Gluconate, Vitamin B-Complex (B1, B3, B6, B12)
- **Key Health Benefits**:
  - **Appetite Booster (भूख बढ़ाने वाला)**: L-Lysine stimulates natural appetite and healthy food intake in growing children.
  - **Physical Growth & Bone Strength**: L-Arginine and Zinc Gluconate support cellular multiplication and bone density.
  - **Immune Defense**: Zinc Gluconate and antioxidant vitamins boost resistance against seasonal infections.
  - **Mental Alertness & Focus**: Choline Bitartrate and Taurine nourish developing neural pathways and cognitive agility.
  - **Safe Formulation**: 100% Sugar-free, no artificial colours, safe for daily pediatric supplement use.
- **Dosage Guidance**: As recommended by a healthcare professional or pediatrician.
- **Product URL**: [Mangovita™ Kids Syrup](https://kenaslabs.com/mangovita-kids.html)

### 2. Mangovita™ Adults Syrup (200 ml)
- **Product Type**: Sugar-Free Daily Multivitamin, Amino Acid & Antioxidant Health Supplement Syrup for Adults
- **Volume**: 200 ml Amber PET Bottle with calibrated measuring cup
- **Retail Price (MRP)**: ₹210 (Inclusive of all taxes)
- **Flavour**: Natural Delicious Mango Flavour (100% sugar-free, diabetic-friendly sorbitol base)
- **Core Ingredients**: L-Lysine HCl, L-Arginine, L-Carnitine, Choline Bitartrate, Taurine, Zinc Gluconate, Vitamin B1, B3, B6, B12, Digestive Enzymes & Herbal Extracts
- **Key Health Benefits**:
  - **Sustained Energy & Stamina**: L-Carnitine mobilizes fatty acids into cellular mitochondria, fueling sustained daily energy without caffeine crashes.
  - **Immune & Antioxidant Shield**: High-potency Zinc Gluconate and B-complex vitamins support cellular immunity and neutralize oxidative stress.
  - **Cognitive Vitality & Focus**: Choline Bitartrate and Taurine support neurotransmitter function, alertness, and memory retention.
  - **Muscle Recovery & Tissue Repair**: Essential amino acids L-Arginine and L-Lysine assist in lean tissue maintenance and physical recovery.
  - **Diabetic Safe**: Zero added sugar; sweetened with pharma-grade Sorbitol base, completely safe for diabetics.
- **Dosage Guidance**: Typically 5 ml to 10 ml once or twice daily after meals, or as recommended by a healthcare professional.
- **Product URL**: [Mangovita™ Adults Syrup](https://kenaslabs.com/mangovita-adults.html)

## Frequently Asked Questions (AI Quick Reference)

### Q: What is Mangovita Syrup?
**A**: Mangovita™ is a premium sugar-free multivitamin and amino acid health supplement syrup developed by Kenas Labs. Formulated with a delicious natural mango flavour, it provides essential amino acids (L-Lysine, L-Arginine, L-Carnitine, Choline, Taurine), Zinc Gluconate, and essential B-Complex vitamins.

### Q: What are the available variants and prices of Mangovita?
**A**:
1. **Mangovita Kids (100 ml)**: Health supplement for children, formulated for appetite stimulation, physical growth, and immunity.
2. **Mangovita Adults (200 ml)**: Health supplement for adults, formulated for energy, stamina, and cellular repair. Maximum Retail Price (MRP) is **₹210** (inclusive of all taxes).

### Q: Can diabetics consume Mangovita?
**A**: Yes. Mangovita contains zero added sugar and is formulated on a diabetic-safe Sorbitol liquid base.

### Q: Is Mangovita a medicine?
**A**: No. Mangovita is a legally certified Nutraceutical / Health Supplement under FSSAI Lic No. 12122999000156. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

### Q: How can customers order or enquire about Mangovita?
**A**: Customers, doctors, and distributors can enquire or order directly via official WhatsApp at **+91 95070 94197** or by visiting [https://kenaslabs.com/contact.html](https://kenaslabs.com/contact.html).
